answer: Deployed through a velvet fork, an agent network mitigates Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral bonds secured by falcon lattice signatures. Each entity must lock capital above a strict collateral ledge, imposing a verifiable liquidity cost and borrowing expense per identity. This prevents adversaries from costlessly multiplying personas. However, the system inherently penalizes capital-poor participants and remains ineffective against well-funded cartels.
